call_purpose: You called because your coupon code was not applying at checkout and showed "Invalid coupon", and because you wanted to use it on the Advanced Course; you also raised the company name in the GST part of your invoice and extending the coupon's expiry date.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you edited the coupon, selected the Advanced Course in the Products section and saved, and you confirmed that the discount now shows at checkout.

covered.text: We explained that the coupon had been assigned only to the Starter Course and not to the Advanced Course, so the product needed to be assigned to it.
We explained that you can extend the coupon's expiry date yourself in the coupon settings, where the date option is available. This is not yet done.
The company name in the GST part of your invoice showing incorrectly is not yet resolved.

customer_next_steps.text: You mentioned that you planned to extend the coupon's expiry date in the coupon settings.
